description:
Tool for capturing and analyzing logs produced by AudioCodes Session Border Controller (SBC), Media Gateway and IP Phone devices.

Syslog Viewer utility can be used for two major tasks:
- Recording and displaying syslog messages from AudioCodes devices (SBC / Gateway / IP Phones)
- Analyzing recorded logs (including support for interactive SIP Flow Diagram)
- AI agents (Claude Code and others) can analyze logs and the open tabs through Syslog Viewer's MCP server: see "Tools > Use with AI Agents".
- Web connector: when a firewall or proxy answers instead of the device, "Show the page" shows its page.
- Fix syslog over TCP and TLS:
  - SIP messages split between two tabs for SBCs that send a host name (regression in v2.50).
  - End of SIP messages with a body shown only when the next message arrived.
  - Lines of filtered-out messages still shown.
- Fix Web connector showing a misleading error instead of "the username or password is incorrect" (devices on 7.40A.605 and 7.40A.607).
